chapterInfo.content:
6
1Enti momma yɛmfa mfitiaseɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa Kristo ho no nto nkyɛn, na yɛmpere nkɔ deɛ ɛyɛ pɛ no mu, na yɛamfa nnwuma funu mu adwensakyera ne Nyankopɔn ho gyidie 2ne asubɔ ahodoɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nsagusoɔ ne awufoɔ sɔreɛ ne daa atemmuo anto fapem bio. 3Yei na sɛ Onyankopɔn ma ho kwan a, yɛbɛyɛ.
4 # Heb 10.26-27; Mat 12.31; 1 Yoh 5.16 Na ɛntumi mma sɛ, wɔn a wɔanya hann pɛn, na wɔaka ɔsoro akyɛdeɛ no ahwɛ, na wɔanya Honhom Kronkron no bie, 5na wɔaka Nyankopɔn asɛm a ɛyɛ ne wiase a ɛrebɛba no ahoɔden ahodoɔ ahwɛ, 6na wɔafiri ho ahwe aseɛ no, wɔbɛdane wɔn foforɔ akɔ adwensakyera mu, wɔn a wɔsɛne Nyankopɔn Ba no bio ma wɔn ho na wɔde no kɔ animguaseɛ mu. 7Na asase a ɛnom osuo a ɛtaa tɔ gu soɔ na ɛfifiri aduane a ɛyɛ ma wɔn a wɔn nti wɔdɔ no, nya Nyankopɔn hɔ nhyira no bi. 8Na deɛ ɛfifiri nkasɛɛ ne hwerɛmo no, ɛmfra, na ɛbɛn nnuabɔ a n’awieeɛ ne ɔhyeɛ.
9Na sɛ yɛka saa nso a, adɔfo, mo fam deɛ, yɛn ani da deɛ ɛyɛ sene saa a ɛbata nkwagyeɛ ho so. 10#Heb 10.32-34 Ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn nyɛ deɛ ɔntene, a ne werɛ bɛfiri mo adwuma ne mo dɔ mmɔden a mobɔɔ no ne din mu, sɛ mosomm ahotefoɔ na moda so som wɔn. 11#Heb 3.14; Flp 1.6 Na yɛyi yɛn yam pɛ sɛ mo nyinaa mmaako mmaako yi saa mmɔdemmɔ yi adi kyerɛ wɔ anidasoɔ a akyinnyeɛ nni mu koraa mu de kɔduru awieeɛ, 12na moanyɛ nyaa, na mmom moayɛ wɔn a wɔnam gyidie ne abodwokyɛre so nyaa bɔhyɛ no asuafoɔ.
Nyankopɔn bɔhyɛ a ɛyɛ nokorɛ
13 # Gye 22.16-17 Na Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ Abraham bɔ no, na ɔnni deɛ ɔso sene no a ɔbɛka ne ntam nti, ɔkaa ɔno ara ne ho ntam 14sɛ: Ampa ara, nhyira na mɛhyira woɔ, na dɔre na mɛma woadɔre. 15Na ɔtɔɔ ne bo ase twɛnee saa no, ne nsa kaa bɔhyɛ no. 16#Eks 22.11 Ɛfiri sɛ nnipa ka deɛ ɔso sene wɔn ntam, na ntuatuaano nyinaa to twa ne ntanka a wɔde hyɛ asɛm mu den. 17Ɛno nti na Onyankopɔn pɛɛ sɛ ɔyi n’atirimusɛm a ɛnsakyera kyerɛ bɔhyɛ no adedifoɔ pefee no, ɔde ntam gyinaa mu, 18na yɛafa nnoɔma mmienu a ɛnsakyera, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn nni atorɔ wɔ biribiara mu no so anya awerɛhyɛmu a emu yɛ den, na yɛn a yɛadwane repɛ hintabea no bɛsɔ anidasoɔ a ɛda yɛn anim no mu. 19Ɛno na yɛwɔ sɛ ɔkra sɛkyɛ a ɛnteɛ, na ɛtim hɔ a ɛhyɛne mu de kɔsi ntwamutam no mu, 20#Heb 5.6 deɛ odikanfoɔ bi hyɛnee hɔ maa yɛn no, ɔno ne Yesu a wayɛ Melkisedek kwan so daa sɔfo panin.

pageProps.chapterText:
Enti momma yɛmfa mfitiaseɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa Kristo ho no nto nkyɛn, na yɛmpere nkɔ deɛ ɛyɛ pɛ no mu, na yɛamfa nnwuma funu mu adwensakyera ne Nyankopɔn ho gyidie ne asubɔ ahodoɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nsagusoɔ ne awufoɔ sɔreɛ ne daa atemmuo anto fapem bio. Yei na sɛ Onyankopɔn ma ho kwan a, yɛbɛyɛ.
Na ɛntumi mma sɛ, wɔn a wɔanya hann pɛn, na wɔaka ɔsoro akyɛdeɛ no ahwɛ, na wɔanya Honhom Kronkron no bie, na wɔaka Nyankopɔn asɛm a ɛyɛ ne wiase a ɛrebɛba no ahoɔden ahodoɔ ahwɛ, na wɔafiri ho ahwe aseɛ no, wɔbɛdane wɔn foforɔ akɔ adwensakyera mu, wɔn a wɔsɛne Nyankopɔn Ba no bio ma wɔn ho na wɔde no kɔ animguaseɛ mu. Na asase a ɛnom osuo a ɛtaa tɔ gu soɔ na ɛfifiri aduane a ɛyɛ ma wɔn a wɔn nti wɔdɔ no, nya Nyankopɔn hɔ nhyira no bi. Na deɛ ɛfifiri nkasɛɛ ne hwerɛmo no, ɛmfra, na ɛbɛn nnuabɔ a n’awieeɛ ne ɔhyeɛ.
Na sɛ yɛka saa nso a, adɔfo, mo fam deɛ, yɛn ani da deɛ ɛyɛ sene saa a ɛbata nkwagyeɛ ho so. Ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn nyɛ deɛ ɔntene, a ne werɛ bɛfiri mo adwuma ne mo dɔ mmɔden a mobɔɔ no ne din mu, sɛ mosomm ahotefoɔ na moda so som wɔn. Na yɛyi yɛn yam pɛ sɛ mo nyinaa mmaako mmaako yi saa mmɔdemmɔ yi adi kyerɛ wɔ anidasoɔ a akyinnyeɛ nni mu koraa mu de kɔduru awieeɛ, na moanyɛ nyaa, na mmom moayɛ wɔn a wɔnam gyidie ne abodwokyɛre so nyaa bɔhyɛ no asuafoɔ.

Na Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ Abraham bɔ no, na ɔnni deɛ ɔso sene no a ɔbɛka ne ntam nti, ɔkaa ɔno ara ne ho ntam sɛ: Ampa ara, nhyira na mɛhyira woɔ, na dɔre na mɛma woadɔre. Na ɔtɔɔ ne bo ase twɛnee saa no, ne nsa kaa bɔhyɛ no. Ɛfiri sɛ nnipa ka deɛ ɔso sene wɔn ntam, na ntuatuaano nyinaa to twa ne ntanka a wɔde hyɛ asɛm mu den. Ɛno nti na Onyankopɔn pɛɛ sɛ ɔyi n’atirimusɛm a ɛnsakyera kyerɛ bɔhyɛ no adedifoɔ pefee no, ɔde ntam gyinaa mu, na yɛafa nnoɔma mmienu a ɛnsakyera, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn nni atorɔ wɔ biribiara mu no so anya awerɛhyɛmu a emu yɛ den, na yɛn a yɛadwane repɛ hintabea no bɛsɔ anidasoɔ a ɛda yɛn anim no mu. Ɛno na yɛwɔ sɛ ɔkra sɛkyɛ a ɛnteɛ, na ɛtim hɔ a ɛhyɛne mu de kɔsi ntwamutam no mu, deɛ odikanfoɔ bi hyɛnee hɔ maa yɛn no, ɔno ne Yesu a wayɛ Melkisedek kwan so daa sɔfo panin.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
